entries.headline: Five USAF transports, Navy drone and three broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported five US Air Force transport aircraft over the United States, a US Navy surveillance drone over the Persian Gulf and three coded military radio broadcasts detected that day.

entries.headline: RAF A400M RRR9946 reported from Al Minhad Air Base
entries.summary: War Watch identified RAF Airbus A400M Atlas RRR9946, registration ZM405 and hex 43C5DF, from Al Minhad Air Base in the UAE with no destination listed, citing a sighting by alexgreen1767.

entries.headline: US Navy MQ-4C OVRLD02 spotted
entries.summary: War Watch identified a US Navy Northrop Grumman MQ-4C Triton using callsign OVRLD02, registration 169172 and hex AE6258, citing a sighting by alexgreen1767.

entries.headline: Bahrain Royal Flight RJ100 BAH20 spotted
entries.summary: War Watch identified a Bahrain Royal Flight Avro RJ100 using callsign BAH20, registration A9C-KAS and hex 8940B6, from Abha Regional Airport, citing a sighting by alexgreen1767.

entries.headline: RAF C-17 ZZ171 reported departing Al Minhad Air Base
entries.summary: War Watch identified RAF C-17 registration ZZ171, hex 43C171, with no callsign or destination listed, departing Al Minhad Air Base in the UAE, citing a sighting by alexgreen1767.

entries.headline: Four USAF transports and surveillance aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported four US Air Force transport aircraft airborne alongside surveillance aircraft monitoring activity over the North Sea and elsewhere.

entries.headline: USAF transport, surveillance and coded-radio activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US Air Force transport aircraft over the North Sea, surveillance aircraft across US airspace and three coded radio broadcasts detected that day.

entries.headline: Spy, transport and command aircraft reported over Atlantic and North Sea
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US military surveillance and transport aircraft across the Atlantic and North Sea, including a nuclear command aircraft broadcasting no callsign.

entries.headline: Command, transport and surveillance aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported US Air Force nuclear command-and-control, transport and surveillance aircraft airborne over the United States, with activity described as busier than usual.

entries.headline: Five USAF transports, one command jet and two broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported five US Air Force transport aircraft and one nuclear command aircraft airborne over the United States, with two coded radio broadcasts heard during the previous hour.

entries.headline: T-45 TALON48 spotted near Alabama–Georgia border
entries.summary: War Watch identified a British Aerospace T-45 Goshawk using callsign TALON48, hex AE6318 and registration 167095 near the Alabama–Georgia border, citing a sighting by reagan0965.

entries.headline: E-3G SENTRY60 spotted
entries.summary: War Watch identified a Boeing E-3G Sentry using callsign SENTRY60, hex AE11EB and registration 80-0138, citing a sighting by reagan0965 and a photo by DVS-135 via Planespotters.net.
